title: finding(app-shell): nothing lints an object validation rule's condition at draft level, and the server fail-closes on a bad one
body:
Found by the `os-dev` seat implementing objectui#8167, and kept out of that PR deliberately: objectui#8167 is about which **editor** mounts declare a CEL lint scope; this is about the **draft-level gate**, which no editor change can close.

## The gap

`clientValidation`'s `validateObjectFieldRules` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/clientValidation.ts`) lints, at `scope: 'record'`:

- every field conditional rule — `visibleWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / `requiredWhen`;
- every `formula` field's `expression`.

⛔ **Nothing lints an object validation rule's `condition` at draft level at all.**

## Why that is not cosmetic

The server does not merely ignore a bad predicate there — it **fail-closes**:

- `objectstack` `packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts:2713` — `checkPredicate(rule, record, previous, …)` binds its context as `{ record, previous }` and nothing else;
- `:2732` — an unevaluable predicate emits `Validation rule '<name>' predicate failed to evaluate (…) — write rejected (#4649)`.

⇒ a bare-shorthand condition (`amount > 100` rather than `record.amount > 100`) is **accepted by the draft gate and then rejects every write to the object**.

## What objectui#8167 does and does not close

objectui#8167's PR gives the inline `ConditionBuilder` mount `scope="record"`, so an author typing into **that editor** now sees the error. ⛔ It closes the editor route only. The **JSON source editor**, **package import** and **AI authoring** routes all reach the draft gate without passing through that editor, and the gate still says nothing.

## Dedup keywords (⛔ not deduped by the filer — this seat files, triage searches)

`validation rule condition` · `clientValidation` · `draft-level lint` · `scope record` · `fail-closed` · `checkPredicate`

## Provenance

Measured on objectui `main` `6d5db7b1` by the dev seat working objectui#8167, and independently re-read by the `domain:ui` execution seat on the same tree plus the objectstack tree for the `rule-validator.ts` half. Routed unlabelled: ⛔ an execution seat does not grade or route.
